meta.description: Altshuller 39x39 contradiction matrix: consensus of independent transcriptions, checked against the 1973 table.
meta.direction: key 'i,j' = (improving parameter i, worsening parameter j); absent key = no principles listed; diagonal not applicable
meta.rule: a cell is accepted when a strict majority of the voting sources agree on the SET of principles; order = most common order among them

cell_status.verified: consensus set equals the Altshuller Foundation 1973 table
cell_status.contested: consensus set differs from the 1973 table; 'alt' holds the 1973 reading. Treat both as candidates
cell_status.consensus: the 1973 page was unreadable for this cell; consensus only

reference_source.use: verification only; not a voting source
